
######  Input Parameter of Standard Intarface  ######

  Open Standard-Mode Inputfile StdFace.def 

  KEYWORD : model                | VALUE : HubbardGC 
  KEYWORD : lattice              | VALUE : orthorhombic 
  KEYWORD : l                    | VALUE : 2 
  KEYWORD : w                    | VALUE : 2 
  KEYWORD : height               | VALUE : 2 
  KEYWORD : u                    | VALUE : 3.0 
  KEYWORD : t                    | VALUE : 1.0 
  KEYWORD : h                    | VALUE : -0.7 
  KEYWORD : gamma                | VALUE : 0.4 
  KEYWORD : gamma_y              | VALUE : 0.25 
  KEYWORD : ncond                | VALUE : 8 

#######  Construct Model  #######

    CDataFileHead = zvo         ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
  @ Lattice Size & Shape

                a = 1.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######
          Wlength = 1.00000     ######  DEFAULT VALUE IS USED  ######

  @ Numerical conditions
